Capture

Create tasks in seconds, not menus.

Type the way you'd text a teammate. C-Rem's natural-language parser pulls out the category, priority, due date and assignee on its own — no dropdowns required.

⌨️
One line in, a full task out"Fix checkout bug tomorrow 3pm @development #p1 +Alex Carter" becomes a scheduled, prioritized, assigned task.
🎙️
Or just say itVoice dictation transcribes what you say and recognizes the same categories, priorities and teammates.
@
Symbols when you want them@category, #priority and +assignee work as shortcuts — plain words work too.
DevelopmentP1 · UrgentOct 1 · 3 PMAlex Carter

Or say it out loud

Work

Every task has context.

Subtasks, a description, due date, labels, reference images and the full discussion — open one task and everything about it is right there, including who said what.

💬
Comments stay on the taskA dedicated chat panel with @mentions means feedback never leaves the thing it's about.
🏷️
Labels, on top of categoriesTag a task "Launch" or "Bug" without changing what project it belongs to.
🖼️
Drop in referencesAttach the mockup, the screenshot, the spec — right where the work is happening.

Never recreate the same task twice.

Set a task to repeat weekly, and the moment it's marked done, C-Rem quietly lines up the next one — same owner, same label, new due date.

Review & Complete

From idea to done.

Move a card across the board with a drag. Work flows left to right, and a task counts as finished the moment it lands in Done, which is also what feeds your streak and your stats.

Assign

Know who's working on what.

See who's online, what they picked up, and how long they've been on it — without asking. Presence and ownership are part of the board, not a separate status meeting.

🟢
Live presenceFour teammates, four current tasks, visible the moment you open the workspace.
🔥
Streaks that actually motivateConsecutive days of shipped work, tracked automatically per person.
Measure

Measure what matters — for you, and for the team.

Personal streaks and category breakdowns sit right next to team rankings and averages. This is a real screenshot from a real (demo) team — not a mockup.

Schedule

See deadlines, not just columns.

Board, List or Calendar — same tasks, three ways to look at them. When a due date matters more than a status, switch to Calendar and see the month laid out, not buried in a column.

Updates

What's new in C-Rem Task Manager.

Every release, newest first. The update notice inside the app brings you here.

Version 2.2.5

Latest
  • Voice dictation tells you what is wrong. If the microphone is blocked or the speech service can't be reached, you now get a clear message, with a shortcut to the Windows microphone settings, instead of the button switching off silently.
  • Keyboard shortcuts work again in the desktop app: F11 for full screen, F5 or Ctrl+R to reload, Ctrl + and Ctrl − to zoom, and F12 for developer tools.
  • Tasks open more reliably. A click with a slightly moving mouse no longer counts as a drag.
  • Drag and drop in List view. Move tasks between statuses and reorder them, the same as on the board.
  • Quick Add: click anywhere in the empty space of the bar to start typing.

Version 2.2.0

  • Real accounts. Sign-in now runs on Firebase Authentication, so your password is checked by Google's sign-in service instead of inside the app.
  • Just your name and password. Returning members sign in without the team password. The team password is only needed the first time you join.
  • Changing your name asks for your password, and there is now a Sign out button in Settings.
  • Your team's data is protected by access rules. You can only read and change the tasks of your own team.
  • Existing teams keep their tasks. Each member creates an account (name and password) the first time they open this version.

Version 2.1.3

  • Fixed tasks being deleted or going missing after an update.
  • Password-protected sign-in. Every account now has its own password, and passwords are stored hashed instead of as plain text.
  • Warnings for easy passwords when you create a team or an account.
  • Existing accounts keep working. The first time you open the app after updating, you are asked to create a password. Your teams and tasks are unchanged.
  • Your data upgrades itself. After an update, a team's older data is converted to the current format automatically.
  • Update from inside the app. When a new version is out, choose Update now. It downloads in the background and installs the next time you close the app.
  • Safer update notices. The link in an update notice only opens the official C-Rem website, and it opens in your browser.
  • Safer renaming. You can no longer take a name that another member of your team already uses.

Version 2.0.0

  • Board, List and Calendar views for the same tasks.
  • Natural-language Quick Add. One line sets the category, priority, due date, time and assignee, using @category, #priority and +assignee.
  • Voice dictation in Quick Add.
  • Task detail with a description, subtasks, images, labels, and a comments panel with @mentions.
  • Multiple labels per task, on top of categories.
  • Priorities P1 to P4, due dates with times, Today, 7 Days and Overdue filters, and sorting by priority.
  • Recurring tasks that repeat daily, weekly or monthly.
  • Search across title, description, category, owner, labels and comments.
  • Team presence, streaks, and personal and team statistics.
  • Light and dark themes, accent colors, and a calmer Simple style.
